title: A stopped control plane is brought back up without a new commit
description: The deploy watch's pass, against a stubbed compose runner and a real health endpoint: with the plane down, no new tip and no deploy running, it runs 'up' for the recorded serving commit within one poll and health returns; a missing-network failure recreates the containers and succeeds; while a deploy is running it does nothing; after three failures exactly one failure reason is recorded where master status and the alert path already read deploy failures. A loop started against an unreachable plane stays running and resumes cycles when the plane answers.

steps.name: the watcher brings a stopped plane back, and the loop waits out an unreachable one
